# Pinned source import

Source reference snapshot copied from andymcca/lr-gpsp-nspire commit
2ddeb23b565cab84e20278bb73ed76f3d91b25f5.

The previously omitted 16 KiB GPL-licensed open replacement BIOS
libretro-gpsp/bios/open_gba_bios.bin has now been restored from the verified
complete Nspire backup. This is the upstream open replacement, not Nintendo's
proprietary BIOS. Its license and corresponding source are retained in
libretro-gpsp/COPYING and libretro-gpsp/bios/source/.

The Run007 workflow still uses its existing pinned upstream checkout.
SDK compiler binaries remain external.
